title: Korean Stir Fry
description: A spicy and savory Korean-inspired stir fry recipe made with peppers and a hint of numbing flavor. Ready in under 30 minutes!

ingredients.name: numbing
ingredients.notes: Korean chili flakes, or to taste

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced peppers and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until they start to soften.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger, and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce and numbing flakes. Pour the mixture over the peppers and stir to coat.
Continue cooking for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the peppers are tender-crisp.
Stir in the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil and sesame oil. Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped green onions and toasted sesame seeds if desired.
